title: Anii language
description: Niger–Congo language spoken in Ghana, Togo and Benin
extract: The Anii is a Guan language which is spoken in Benin, central-eastern Togo and central eastern Ghana by Makɔ-Makua or Bakɔ-Bakua clan. It is part of the geographic group of Ghana Togo Mountain languages of the Kwa branch of Niger–Congo.
